title: WF03 OBS-02 connection-refused blocker: obs02 HTTP integration tests lacked token-gated harness precondition
summary: OBS-02 integration tests were attempting outbound HTTP checks without the same token-gated harness precondition already used by related integration suites, causing repeated CONNECTION_REFUSED skips when BPM_TEST_URL was unavailable.

root_cause.details: tests/integration/obs02_metrics_test.zig did not enforce BPM_TEST_TOKEN precondition before making HTTP requests, so partial environments surfaced network-level CONNECTION_REFUSED outcomes instead of deterministic prerequisite skips.

resolution.strategy: Apply known ISSUE-FIXER pattern from ISS-0007 to align preconditions across HTTP integration suites.
changes: Added testHarnessToken helper in tests/integration/obs02_metrics_test.zig to require BPM_TEST_TOKEN
Invoked token precondition in TC-OBS-02-INT-01/02/03 before outbound HTTP calls
Updated file-level harness comments to document BPM_TEST_TOKEN requirement

commands.command: $env:BPM_TEST_URL='http://127.0.0.1:8080'; Remove-Item Env:BPM_TEST_TOKEN -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; zig test tests/integration/obs02_metrics_test.zig --test-filter TC-OBS-02-INT
commands.detail: Tests now skip explicitly on missing BPM_TEST_TOKEN precondition and no longer report CONNECTION_REFUSED as the gating cause in partial harness environments.

prevention: Enforce token-gated preconditions consistently across HTTP integration tests that require external harness availability.
Document required integration env vars in each suite header to prevent ambiguous connection errors during CI/local execution.
